claim_verbatim: Germany’s planned 2026 abolition of double-counting for Annex IX waste feedstocks will effectively double domestic HVO demand overnight.
source: Essay: The Pilbara Runs on a 10-Day Fuel Tank
resolution_criterion: YES if Germany's abolition of double-counting for Annex IX / advanced-biofuel feedstocks is in force for the 2026 compliance year AND a recognised source (Argus, UFOP, BLE or BAFA) shows 2026 German physical HVO or advanced-biofuel demand at least 1.8x the 2025 volume; NO if the abolition is in force and 2026 physical demand is under 1.8x 2025; NO if the abolition is not in force for compliance year 2026.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if Germany's abolition of double-counting for Annex IX / advanced-biofuel feedstocks is in force for the 2026 compliance year AND a recognised source (Argus, UFOP, BLE or BAFA) shows 2026 German physical HVO or advanced-biofuel demand at least 1.8x the 2025 volume; NO if the abolition is in force and 2026 physical demand is under 1.8x 2025; NO if the abolition is not in force for compliance year 2026.
resolution_source_planned: German RED III / GHG-quota legislation; Argus, UFOP, BLE or BAFA biofuel volumes
mechanism: Ending double-counting forces obligated parties to buy physical litres instead of paper credits, so domestic HVO demand doubles when the rule bites.
notes: Year not finished as of 2026-10-09, left open. Cabinet had approved a draft in Dec 2025 to drop double-counting from the 2026 compliance year; passage by 9 Oct 2026 was not confirmed here and is not assumed. 'Double' is scored as at least 1.8x, fixed now.

claim_verbatim: Government-backed SAF producers and European transport mandates will outbid Pilbara miners for every available drop of feedstock.
source: Essay: The Pilbara Runs on a 10-Day Fuel Tank
resolution_criterion: YES if by end-2030 no Pilbara Tier-1 iron-ore producer has displaced 10% or more of haul-truck diesel with HVO, and company filings or trade press attribute the gap to European SAF or road-mandate feedstock competition; NO if any Pilbara Tier-1 is running HVO at 10% or more of haulage diesel volume.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by end-2030 no Pilbara Tier-1 iron-ore producer has displaced 10% or more of haul-truck diesel with HVO, and company filings or trade press attribute the gap to European SAF or road-mandate feedstock competition; NO if any Pilbara Tier-1 is running HVO at 10% or more of haulage diesel volume.
resolution_source_planned: BHP, Rio Tinto or Fortescue filings; Argus or equivalent biofuel trade press
mechanism: EU ReFuelEU and RED III mandates let SAF producers and European transport outbid miners for waste lipids.
notes: 'Every available drop' is absolute. The fixed rule uses a 10% haulage-diesel displacement threshold so the call can be scored. That threshold is the ledger's, not his.

claim_verbatim: This dynamic will invariably lead to severe balance-of-payments crises, potential sovereign defaults, and forced debt restructurings through multilateral institutions by late 2027.
context: Additional to the first harvest of this essay. 'Potential' qualifies defaults; the invariable clause is the balance-of-payments crisis.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if by 2027-12-31 the IMF has approved a new program, an augmentation, or a sovereign debt restructuring for at least one large net food-importing emerging economy, and the IMF or that sovereign links the stress to food, fertiliser or import-price pressure; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by 2027-12-31 the IMF has approved a new program, an augmentation, or a sovereign debt restructuring for at least one large net food-importing emerging economy, and the IMF or that sovereign links the stress to food, fertiliser or import-price pressure; NO otherwise.
mechanism: Import-dependent countries pay scarcity premiums for food while local farmers cannot get reagent inputs.
notes: Additional claim missed on the first pass of this essay. Not the same sentence as the fertiliser-price or food-inflation calls already logged.

claim_verbatim: Resource Fratricide: Before we fight China, we will likely see a trade war between the US and the EU for offtake agreements.
context: Additional to the first harvest of Return of Matter.
resolution_criterion: YES if by 2028-12-31 the US and the EU have imposed a trade, export or offtake measure aimed at securing copper or critical-mineral supply against each other, or official sources describe mutually exclusive offtake deals between them; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by 2028-12-31 the US and the EU have imposed a trade, export or offtake measure aimed at securing copper or critical-mineral supply against each other, or official sources describe mutually exclusive offtake deals between them; NO otherwise.
resolution_source_planned: USTR, European Commission, or equivalent official notices
mechanism: Germany needs copper for the EV transition while the US needs it for AI, so allies compete for offtake before any fight with China.
notes: Additional. No calendar date in the sentence. Window fixed at end-2028. 'Before we fight China' is sequencing, not a condition that a Pacific war must occur.
